what: the three assertions that turned the gate RED on test/web.test.mjs, their cause and their fix

failures.test: parity: the same seed builds the same organism in the browser port
failures.cause: seeds/organism.mjs was edited today at 15:11:25 -0400 (mtime), adding the six grid kinds to the perception roster and seq.fit to the cognitive roster. web/src/organism.js, last written 2026-09-16 22:19:31 -0400, still carried the old two rosters, so the browser port grew a different organism.
failures.fix: the two rosters in web/src/organism.js now carry the same entries in the same order as seeds/organism.mjs

failures.test: parity: cell identity, kind, region and circuit agree cell for cell
failures.cause: same cause: the perception roster is cycled in order, so a roster short by six entries puts a different kind in every major past the tenth cell.
failures.fix: same fix; cell 10 is grid.rotate on both sides now

failures.test: parity: ports and delays agree edge for edge
failures.assertion:
AssertionError: Expected values to be strictly equal:

3355 !== 3395
failures.cause: same cause: a different roster is a different acceptor index, so a different edge set.

alsoChanged: web/src/kinds.js gained seven rows: grid.crop, grid.flip, grid.rotate, grid.tile, grid.translate, grid.transpose (in:event / out:event, update inert) and seq.fit (terms:event / next:event, update predict). Without them the browser table cannot host the new roster entries at all.

test/web.test.mjs: the kind count floor moved from 47 to 54, the number the test itself printed, following the roster change in seeds/organism.mjs. The per kind port comparison against the node registry is untouched.
